title: EEZ Composer queue
description: Composer-owned cross-chain queue membership. Native Reth chain metrics are not used because embedded L1 and L2 share a recorder.

panels.title: Composer scrape
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the process. This does not establish queue collection or settlement health.

panels.title: Queue sample age
panels.description: Age of the last successful membership/telemetry sample. Sampling and scraping run every second. Queue charts hide samples at least 10 seconds old. This timestamp is independent of source-state evaluation.

panels.title: Queued cross-chain requests
panels.description: Held requests awaiting composition, including requests that may be blocked or not yet evaluated. Inbound originates on L1; outbound originates on L2. Values are sampled; brief transitions may not be visible. Missing or stale telemetry is a gap, never an empty queue. Queue state is in memory and may reset on restart.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",state="queued"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: In-flight cross-chain requests
panels.description: Outstanding held-pool reservations, including composition and waiting for settlement evidence. This is not the number of concurrently executing requests or a count of all unsettled historical transactions. Values are sampled; brief transitions may not be visible. Missing or stale telemetry is a gap, never an empty queue. Queue state is in memory and may reset on restart.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",state="in_flight"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Last evaluation age
panels.description: Age of the last source-state evaluation start, not sample age or completion time. It may increase when idle. Unknown before evaluation or after reorg invalidation. Read alongside the last-evaluated readiness charts.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_evaluation_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Last-evaluated queue readiness
panels.description: Cached ready / blocked / unknown classifications of queued requests across both directions. They sum to queued membership in each pool snapshot. Consult Last evaluation age: a fresh sample does not establish fresh readiness. In-flight work is excluded.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_queue_readiness_requests{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Last-evaluated blocking reasons
panels.description: Queued requests blocked by nonce, fee, balance or escrow, including affected successors. Across both directions. These are cached observations from the last evaluated source state; consult Last evaluation age.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_queue_blocked_requests{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Oldest tracked pending request
panels.description: Age since the earliest retained in-memory admission among queued and in-flight requests. Replacement starts a new admission. Recovery preserves retained timestamps. Empty queue or missing history is unknown. This is not end-to-end latency.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_oldest_pending_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Metrics endpoint scrape duration
panels.description: Prometheus still fetches and parses the full Reth endpoint before retaining the allowlisted queue metrics. Scrape interval and timeout are one second. This measures scrape elapsed time, not CPU overhead.

panels.title: Last cross-chain completion age
panels.description: Local observation time of the latest retained canonical cross-chain completion. Unknown on restart or invalidating reorg. A quiet period is not automatically a stall; use the Settlement dashboard for policy triggers and submission observations.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_last_completion_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)
